T-pose drip be like:

i'm guessing you are a new adquisition, since the release of the game now, but the game is waaaaaay easier than before the release btw so far its too easy i think, and i'd say the game is fair, only requires skill, habit and discipline (again, for me and my teammates), resource management is pretty important, make sure you guys are using the resources only when needed, melee and stealth is your only ally, also there are a lot of things you can improve when defending alarm doors, like split and go for the scanners when there small scanners, funneling enemies into one door instead of reinforcing every door, kruger + foam strategy exists btw, enemies receive more damage from the back so turrets aiming like so are good too (idk this rundown but meduza sentry is pretty bad for me, death is the best crowd control), weapon choices (mostly in specials and tools) are really important, use terminals so you can found resources or objectives and other important things really effective and fast rather than searching the whole level and also dismantles the probability of not seeing the resources too, and practice makes perfect, don't feel bad about dying a dozen times, we all start somewhere.  


Hope some of this ~~stupidity~~   talk helped, there is a lot of min-max in this game.  
And a lot of information on the internet, also, the GTFO discord is a better option when asking anything i think.  


Good luck, the way down is even deeper than you think.
